description: Source code for the 'Parser' class in the 'net::der' namespace, implementing ASN.1 DER parsing functions.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing ASN.1 DER encoded data, providing methods to read tags, values, and specific data types.

methods.name: PeekTagAndValue
methods.description: Peeks at the next ASN.1 tag and value without advancing the parser.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the parser by the length of the last read tag/value.

methods.name: HasMore
methods.description: Checks if there is more data to parse.

methods.name: ReadRawTLV
methods.description: Reads the next raw TLV (Tag-Length-Value) element.

methods.name: ReadTagAndValue
methods.description: Reads the next tag and its associated value.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag
methods.description: Reads an optional tag, setting output if present.

methods.name: ReadOptionalTag (overload)
methods.description: Reads an optional tag, indicating presence with a boolean.

methods.name: SkipOptionalTag
methods.description: Skips an optional tag if present.

methods.name: ReadTag
methods.description: Reads a specific tag and its value.

methods.name: ReadConstructed
methods.description: Reads a constructed ASN.1 type and initializes a new parser with its content.

methods.name: ReadBitString
methods.description: Reads a bit string, returning an optional.
